# TASK: REFACTOR & MIGRATE "ARYORITHM TECHNOLOGIES" TO MODULAR NEXT.JS (APP ROUTER)

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
You are an expert Full-Stack Engineer and Systems Designer. Migrate the deep-tech corporate web application "Aryorithm Technologies" (Sub-Millisecond Active Defense for Sovereign Infrastructure) from a client-side Babel/React hash-routed prototype into a highly modular, enterprise-grade Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS project.


The application must be 100% self-contained, air-gapped ready (zero external runtime CDN links), strictly typed, and decomposed into decoupled data arrays, modular UI components, and clean page routes.


---


## 2. DESIGN SYSTEM & TAILWIND CONFIGURATION


### A. Theme Colors (`tailwind.config.ts` / CSS variables)
- `void`: `#07090E` (Primary background)
- `panel`: `#0D111A` (Card and terminal surface)
- `hairline`: `#1A2232` (Structural borders and dividers)
- `cyan` (accent): `#00E5FF` (Primary telemetry and active states)
- `kernel`: `#00FFA3` (Safe / verified status)
- `threat`: `#FF3366` (Breach / hazard / critical alert)
- `telemetry`: `#FFB800` (Warning / latency metrics)
- `ink`: `#F0F4F8` (Primary typography)
- `muted`: `#8A99AD` (Secondary / descriptive labels)


### B. Typography (`next/font/google`)
- Display / Headings: `Space Grotesk` (400, 500, 600, 700)
- Body: `Inter` (300, 400, 500, 600)
- Monospace / Telemetry / Code: `JetBrains Mono` (400, 500, 700)


### C. Visual Effects & Utilities (`app/globals.css`)
- `.grid-backdrop`: 72px × 72px hairline grid pattern.
- `.radial-fade`: Radial gradient `ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 0%` with `#00E5FF1A`.
- `.glow-cyan`: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35), 0 0 24px -6px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.55)`.
- Keyframes & animations:
  - `pip-pulse`: 1.8s ease-in-out infinite telemetry indicator.
  - `ring-expand`: 2.4s expanding radar ping.
  - `sweep-line`: 3.2s radar scanning animation.
  - `caret-blink`: 1s terminal caret blink.
  - `enclave-pulse`: 3.4s subtle gradient breathing effect.
- `.tabular`: Tabular numerals (`tnum 1`) for all telemetry counters and latency readouts.


---


## 3. ARCHITECTURE & FOLDER STRUCTURE


Organize the codebase with strict separation of concerns:


```text
├── app/
│   ├── layout.tsx                     # Global root layout (Header, Footer, fonts, skip-link)
│   ├── page.tsx                       # Page 01: Global Homepage
│   ├── platform/nexus/page.tsx        # Page 02: Sentinel Nexus (:9443 HUD)
│   ├── products/sentinel/page.tsx     # Page 03: Blackbox Sentinel
│   ├── technology/
│   │   ├── xinfer/page.tsx            # Page 04: xInfer Engine
│   │   ├── blackbox/page.tsx          # Page 05: Blackbox Core
│   │   └── forge/page.tsx             # Page 06: xInfer Forge
│   ├── research/sentinel-lab/page.tsx # Page 07: Sentinel Lab (SLAB Protocol)
│   ├── about/page.tsx                 # Page 08: Mission & Sovereignty (Manifesto)
│   ├── team/page.tsx                  # Page 09: Team & Careers (eBPF Challenge)
│   ├── pricing/page.tsx               # Page 10: Sovereign Licensing & ROI Calculator
│   ├── contact/page.tsx               # Page 11: Defense Procurement & Hardware Sizer
│   ├── portal/page.tsx                # Page 12: Customer Enclave Portal (License Envelope)
│   ├── insights/page.tsx              # Page 13: Publications & Telemetry Analysis
│   ├── faq/page.tsx                   # Page 14: Engineering FAQ
│   └── trust/page.tsx                 # Page 15: Sovereign Trust & SBOM Repository
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── Header.tsx                 # Top navigation with dropdowns, active route pip
│   │   ├── Footer.tsx                 # Global footer with multi-column links
│   │   ├── MobileDrawer.tsx           # Full responsive mobile menu
│   │   └── Breadcrumb.tsx             # Navigation hierarchy tracker
│   ├── ui/
│   │   ├── CodeViewer.tsx             # Monospace code block with copy button and line highlight
│   │   ├── CopyButton.tsx             # Robust clipboard copy with fallback
│   │   ├── TelemetryCounter.tsx       # Live numeric ticker / tabular display
│   │   ├── Accordion.tsx              # Reusable collapsible row for FAQs & Controls
│   │   └── StatusBadge.tsx            # Cyan / Kernel / Threat / Telemetry pill badges
│   ├── simulations/                   # Interactive client-side engines
│   │   ├── TopologyCanvas.tsx         # Network graph canvas simulation
│   │   ├── RoiCalculator.tsx          # Dual-slider cloud vs on-prem cost calculator
│   │   ├── HardwareSizer.tsx          # Throughput x backend constraint validator
│   │   ├── EbpfChallenge.tsx          # Pointer alignment verifier interactive puzzle

│   └── compliance.ts
└── lib/
    ├── clipboard.ts                   # Universal copy handler with fallback
    └── formatters.ts                  # Currency, bytes, and microsecond formatters
4. DETAILED SPECIFICATION OF KEY INTERACTIVE PAGES
1. Global Shell & Navigation (components/layout/Header.tsx, Footer.tsx)
Navigation structure: Platform, Products, Technology, Research, Company, Pricing.


Active route detection using Next.js usePathname() with a glowing cyan pip indicator.


Hash deep-linking support (/pricing#roi-calculator, /trust#sbom-repository).


Accessibility: Hidden .skip-link pointing to #main-content, semantic tags (header, main, footer).


2. Homepage (app/page.tsx)
Canvas topology animation: Real-time particle/node simulation representing distributed edge appliances.


Interactive latency comparator: Deterministic eBPF (0.84 µs) vs Cloud SIEM/EDR (15–60 s).


Live interactive CLI terminal simulating nexus-ctl status --verbose.


3. Pricing & Licensing (app/pricing/page.tsx)
4 Tiers: Open Research ($0), Edge Appliance ($4,800/node/yr), Sentinel Nexus (Custom), Sovereign Enclave (Classified).


Interactive ROI Calculator (components/simulations/RoiCalculator.tsx):


Slider 1: Deployed Sites (1 to 500).


Slider 2: Daily Telemetry Volume (10 GB to 10 TB, logarithmic scale).


Compute Cloud Cost vs. Aryorithm On-Premises ($0 egress model).


Output: Total 5-year savings and cost-reduction percentage.


4. Defense Procurement (app/contact/page.tsx)
Intake Portals: 3 interactive tabs (Enterprise POC, Defense & Government with CAGE/DUNS validation, Hardware Sizing).


Hardware Sizer (components/simulations/HardwareSizer.tsx):


Selectors: Network Throughput (1/10/40/100 GbE) × Silicon Backend × Thermal Envelope.


Emits real-time engineering warnings for invalid combinations (e.g., 100 GbE on DIN-rail passively cooled).


PGP Security Card:


Fingerprint: 9E42 81BC D34A 7F60 2B18 90C4 EE12 3409 A1F8 6100.


Working copy button for full ED25519/4096-bit public key block.


5. Sovereign Trust & Attestation (app/trust/page.tsx)
Compliance Matrix: Expandable accordions for CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171, IEC 62443, and NIS2/CER.


Verifiable SBOM Repository: SHA-256 digests for libxinfer.so v2.4.1, libblackbox.so v3.1.0, and sentinel-nexus.iso v6.4.2 with copy hashes and SPDX/CycloneDX actions.


6. Sentinel Lab & Engineering Challenges (app/team/page.tsx & app/research/sentinel-lab/page.tsx)
Team page: Interactive eBPF verifier challenge:


Displays raw C/eBPF code hazard (EBPF-XDP-2026).


Action buttons: "Inspect Vulnerability" and "Apply Pointer Alignment Fix".


Interactive state transition to PASS (0 misaligned loads).


Customer Portal (app/portal/page.tsx):


Air-Gapped License Activation generator with sealed envelope animation.


5. REFACTORING GUIDELINES
No Monolithic JSX: Never place huge data matrices inside component JSX. Extract all tabular rows, feature lists, pricing matrices, and code snippets into strongly typed files in data/.


Server vs. Client Components:


Mark interactive elements (calculators, canvas, accordions, copy buttons) with 'use client'.


Keep page wrappers, headers, footers, and static layouts as Server Components for maximum SEO and performance.


Robust Clipboard Utility: Replace raw navigator.clipboard.writeText with a resilient fallback mechanism that handles non-secure origins and sandboxed environments seamlessly.


Clean Code & Modularity: Write clean, readable, modular TypeScript code with descriptive props and interfaces for every single component.




---


### شیوهٔ پیاده‌سازی گام‌به‌گام (Best Practice برای شروع در Next.js)


1. **ایجاد پروژه تمیز Next.js:**
   ```bash
   npx create-next-app@latest aryorithm-next --typescript --tailwind --app --eslint
کپی کردن استایل‌ها: فایل css/style.css فعلی موجود در درایو را به app/globals.css منتقل کرده و رنگ‌ها و فونت‌ها را مطابق پرامپت در tailwind.config.ts اضافه کنید.


انتقال داده‌ها به data/: ثابت‌هایی مثل MODULES (۲۶ ماژول)، TIERS، FRAMEWORKS و کدهای اسمبلی/C++ را مستقیماً از فایل‌های JSX قدیمی به فایل‌های .ts داخل فولدر data/ استخراج کنید.


تزریق پرامپت به ادیتور/دستیار: پرامپت بالا را به ابزار مد نظرتان (مثلاً در Cursor با فعال بودن حالت Composer یا به صورت ماژول به ماژول) بدهید تا کامپوننت‌ها و صفحات ۱۵‌گانه را با معماری استاندارد App Router پیاده‌سازی کند.

11: ## 1. Architecture
12: 
13: Each page is an **IIFE-scoped** module publishing onto a single `window.ARY` namespace. This is required, not
14: stylistic: separate in-browser Babel `<script>` tags share one global lexical scope, so a top-level `const TOKEN`
15: in two files would throw a redeclaration error.
16: 
17: ```
18: js/shared.jsx         Tokens, hooks, router, Link, Breadcrumb, CodeViewer, copyText, Header, Footer, ClosingCTA
19: js/page-home.jsx      Page 01 → window.ARY.HomePage

28: js/page-trust.jsx     Page 15 → window.ARY.TrustPage
29: js/router.jsx         Route table + ReactDOM mount (must load last)
30: ```

# Aryorithm Technologies — Corporate Web Presence

**Domain:** `aryorithm.com`
**Company:** Aryorithm Technologies — Deep-Tech Cyber-Physical Security, Autonomous Edge AI, Heterogeneous Silicon Runtime Engineering
**Tagline:** *Deterministic Sub-Millisecond Active Defense for Sovereign Infrastructure*

**Delivered:** Phase 1 (Page 01) · Phase 2 (Pages 02–03) · Phase 3 (Pages 04–06) · Phase 4 (Pages 08, 10, 11, 15) — **10 routes** on a shared shell and client-side router.

---

## 1. Architecture

Each page is an **IIFE-scoped** module publishing onto a single `window.ARY` namespace. This is required, not
stylistic: separate in-browser Babel `<script>` tags share one global lexical scope, so a top-level `const TOKEN`
in two files would throw a redeclaration error.

```
js/shared.jsx         Tokens, hooks, router, Link, Breadcrumb, CodeViewer, copyText, Header, Footer, ClosingCTA
js/page-home.jsx      Page 01 → window.ARY.HomePage
js/page-nexus.jsx     Page 02 → window.ARY.NexusPage
js/page-sentinel.jsx  Page 03 → window.ARY.SentinelPage
js/page-xinfer.jsx    Page 04 → window.ARY.XInferPage
js/page-blackbox.jsx  Page 05 → window.ARY.BlackboxPage
js/page-forge.jsx     Page 06 → window.ARY.ForgePage
js/page-about.jsx     Page 08 → window.ARY.AboutPage
js/page-pricing.jsx   Page 10 → window.ARY.PricingPage
js/page-contact.jsx   Page 11 → window.ARY.ContactPage
js/page-trust.jsx     Page 15 → window.ARY.TrustPage
js/router.jsx         Route table + ReactDOM mount (must load last)
```

**Routing.** Hash grammar `#<path>[@<section-id>]`, e.g. `#/technology/forge@safety-gate`. `Link` renders a real
`href` and forces the scroll handoff when the target hash equals the current one. `<main>` is keyed by path so
page-local simulations reset on navigation. Unknown paths fall back to `/`. The closing POC panel is suppressed on
`/contact` (it would link to the page you are already reading).

**Navigation.** Six top-level groups: Platform, Products, Technology, Research, **Company** (Mission, Trust,
Standards, Procurement) and **Pricing**. Active route is marked with a cyan pip; the mobile drawer mirrors the
full tree and closes on navigation.

---

## 2. Pages

### Pages 01–06 (Phases 1–3, unchanged)
Homepage with Canvas topology, telemetry counters, latency comparator and `nexus-ctl` CLI · Sentinel Nexus
`:9443` HUD with five capability simulations · Blackbox Sentinel form factors, 26-module matrix and 30 plugins ·
xInfer Engine 15-platform silicon matrix with DMA drawers · Blackbox Core six-stage fast-path and kernel
deep-dives · xInfer Forge MAE/InfoNCE pipeline and golden-attack safety gate.

### Page 10 — Pricing & Licensing (`/pricing`)
- **Hero:** `[ PREDICTABLE SOVEREIGN LICENSING ]`, blueprint headline/subheadline verbatim, plus a "metering we do not do" card.
- **4-tier matrix:** Open Research ($0), Edge Appliance ($4,800/node/yr, flagged *Most Deployed*), Sentinel Nexus (Custom), Sovereign/Defense Enclave (Classified) — each with its specified feature set and CTA style (ghost / solid cyan / cyan outline / ghost).
- **ROI calculator:** two live sliders (1–500 sites, 10 GB–10 TB/day on a logarithmic scale). Cloud model meters ingest ($2.50/GB), egress ($0.09/GB), 12-month retention, indexing compute and per-site collectors; Aryorithm model charges node licences with a genuine $0.00 egress line. Emerald savings readout with a one-shot reveal animation, cost-reduction percentage, 5-year saving and egress saved.

### Page 15 — Sovereign Trust (`/trust`)
- **Hero:** `[ CONTINUOUS ATTESTATION & GOVERNANCE ]`, blueprint headline/subheadline verbatim, verification-posture card.
- **Regulatory crosswalks:** three expandable frameworks. CMMC 2.0/NIST SP 800-171 (AC.L2-3.1.1 TPM-bound identity, SI.L2-3.14.1 sub-millisecond mitigation, AU.L2-3.3.1 SHA-256 signed PCAP carving via `22_dfir`), IEC 62443-3-3/4-2 (zone boundary protection, Modbus/DNP3/PROFINET/S7Comm constraint validation), NIS2/CER (fail-safe during WAN partition, SBOM supply-chain). Every control expands to parent control, evidence artefact and a link to the implementing subsystem.
- **SBOM repository:** `libxinfer.so v2.4.1`, `libblackbox.so v3.1.0`, `sentinel-nexus.iso v6.4.2` with full copyable SHA-256 digests and SPDX / CycloneDX / GPG download actions, plus the "Zero External CDN Dependencies Verified" badge.

### Page 08 — Mission & Sovereignty (`/about`)
- **Manifesto:** blueprint headline and narrative verbatim ("autopsies, not defense"; "local, deterministic, and physically attested"), alongside a physical-consequence timeline (0.84 µs XDP_DROP → 4 ms relay → 20 ms governor → 250 ms breaker → 15–60 s cloud alert).
- **Four Pillars:** Zero Cloud Dependencies, Deterministic Fast-Paths, Cryptographic Hardware Identity, Data Sovereignty — expandable glow-bordered cards with engineering rationale, three verifiable proof rows each, and a cross-link to the implementing page. Closes with a "What This Costs Us" section naming the commercial trade-offs.

### Page 11 — Defense Procurement (`/contact`)
- **Hero:** `[ ENCRYPTED INTAKE & CLEARANCE ]`, blueprint headline/subheadline verbatim, three desk addresses.
- **Three intake portals:** Enterprise POC (validated organisation/contact/email/sites, environment and form-factor selectors), Defense & Government (CAGE 5-alphanumeric and DUNS 9-digit format validation, clearance and facility security levels, with an explicit warning not to enter classified/CUI detail), Hardware Sizing (1/10/40/100GbE × silicon backend × thermal envelope → model recommendation, appliance count, indicative licence, and amber engineering warnings for physically impossible combinations).
- **PGP panel:** full fingerprint `9E42 81BC D34A 7F60 2B18 90C4 EE12 3409 A1F8 6100`, ED25519 / 4096-bit RSA, Amsterdam Research Facility, with a working Copy Public PGP Key button and emerald "Copied to Clipboard!" confirmation.

---

## 3. Verification Performed

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| All 10 routes mount | Driven probe: every page root mounted with correct `document.title`, **JS ERRORS: none** |
| Interactive element census | P10: 2 ROI sliders + 4 tier cards · P11: 3 intake tabs + PGP button + full fingerprint present · P15: 3 framework cards |
| P10 ROI live recompute | 120 sites / 2.0 TB per day → cloud $2,371,724 vs Aryorithm $576,000 → savings $1,795,724 at 76% |
| P10 footnote consistency | 91% claim verified against the model at its stated condition (47 GB/day/site) |
| P11 sizing validation | 100GbE + DIN-Rail correctly emits both engineering warnings and escalates the recommendation to S-5000 |
| P11 clipboard | Button reaches `✓ Key In Clipboard`; tooltip renders beside it after the overflow-clip fix |
| P15 crosswalk + SBOM | CMMC AC.L2-3.1.1 expands with parent control and evidence; all three artefacts show full hashes and actions |
| P08 manifesto + pillars | Blueprint copy verbatim; pillar 02 expands with all three proof rows |
| Mobile 390px (08/10/11/15) | No horizontal overflow on any page; cards stack, sliders/tabs/chips wrap, hashes truncate inside their boxes |
| Page 01 regression | Header, hero, canvas intact; nav now shows Company + Pricing |

### Two defects found and fixed during this phase
1. **Clipboard copy silently failed.** The async Clipboard API *rejects* (rather than being absent) in headless browsers, non-secure origins and some embedded webviews. The original code only feature-detected, so the rejection hit the `catch` and suppressed the confirmation. Replaced with a shared `copyText` helper that catches the rejection and falls back to the legacy selection path — now used by the PGP panel, the SBOM hash rows and every CodeViewer.
2. **PGP tooltip was clipped.** It used a negative `-top-2` offset inside an `overflow-hidden` figure. Moved into the padding box beside the button.

---

## 4. Functional Entry URIs

| Route | Page |
|---|---|
| `#/` | Page 01 — Global Homepage |
| `#/platform/nexus` | Page 02 — Sentinel Nexus |
| `#/products/sentinel` | Page 03 — Blackbox Sentinel |
| `#/technology/xinfer` | Page 04 — xInfer Engine |
| `#/technology/blackbox` | Page 05 — Blackbox Core |
| `#/technology/forge` | Page 06 — xInfer Forge |
| `#/about` | Page 08 — Mission & Sovereignty |
| `#/pricing` | Page 10 — Pricing & Licensing |
| `#/contact` | Page 11 — Defense Procurement |
| `#/trust` | Page 15 — Sovereign Trust |

**Deep links:** `#/pricing@licensing-matrix`, `#/pricing@roi-calculator`, `#/trust@regulatory-crosswalks`,
`#/trust@sbom-repository`, `#/about@four-pillars`, `#/contact@intake-portals`, `#/contact@pgp-panel`,
`#/technology/forge@safety-gate` (auto-opens Step 3), `#/products/sentinel@subsystem-matrix`, and the
Phase 1–3 anchors listed in the nav.

---

## 5. Not Yet Implemented

- **Pages 07, 09, 12, 13, 14** of the blueprint (subsystem detail pages, Research/Sentinel-Lab, Careers, Legal, Enclave Login).
- Real `Customer Enclave Login` authentication — still an anchor. **A static site cannot secure this**; any credential check in this JavaScript is readable in page source.
- **No form on this site transmits data to a server.** This is a deliberate, disclosed design decision, not an omission: a static site has no backend, so the intake portals validate client-side and then hand off to an out-of-band encrypted mail channel. The Contact page states this explicitly rather than implying a submission was received or encrypted. Wiring real intake requires a backend endpoint or a third-party form service.
- Live data. Every metric, benchmark, hash, PCR bank and counter is a deterministic client-side simulation or illustrative placeholder. **The SHA-256 digests and PGP key block are illustrative** and must be replaced with real release artefacts before publication.
- Preprint PDF and datasheet downloads (SBOM/GPG buttons are inert pending real artefacts).
- **Build tooling — now the blocking item, see below.**

---

## 6. Recommended Next Steps

1. **Precompile before any further pages. This is now blocking.**
   The browser downloads Babel and transforms **~350 KB of JSX across twelve scripts on every page load**. Cold load
   measured 13 s at three pages and 65 s at seven; it has grown roughly linearly with each phase and is now the
   dominant cost of the site. Moving to Vite (precompiled JSX + Tailwind CLI) collapses this to one hashed bundle
   and simultaneously makes true the "no external CDNs / air-gapped UI" claim that Page 01's comparison matrix and
   Page 15's compliance badge both assert. Everything below is smaller than this one item.
2. Replace illustrative SHA-256 digests and the PGP public key block with real signed release artefacts.
3. Promote the router to History API paths behind a static rewrite, keeping hash as fallback.
4. Extract the repeated accordion-panel pattern (now in Pages 02, 05, 06, 08, 15) into one shared component, and move content datasets into `js/data/`.
5. Wire the intake portals to a real endpoint, and scope enclave login to an IdP.

---

## 7. Data Models & Storage

Fully static and stateless — no table schemas, no RESTful Table API usage, no persistence. Datasets are
declarative constants inside page modules:

- **shared:** `NAV`, `FOOTER_COLUMNS`, `ROUTES`, `SYNTAX`
- **page-home:** `EDGE_NODES`, `TELEMETRY`, `DIVIDE_ROWS`, `CLOUD_STAGES`, `TIERS`, `CLI_COMMANDS`
- **page-nexus:** `FLEET_REGIONS`, `VECTOR_SAMPLES`, `CANARY_STAGES`, `PCR_BANK`, `CAPABILITIES`
- **page-sentinel:** `FORM_FACTORS`, `MODULES` (26), `PLUGIN_GROUPS` (30)
- **page-xinfer:** `PLATFORMS` (15), `CLASSES`, `CPP_SNIPPET`
- **page-blackbox:** `STAGES` (6), `FRAME_TYPES`, `IDENTITY_TIERS`, `XDP_SNIPPET`, `RING_SNIPPET`
- **page-forge:** `FEATURE_NAMES` (32), `GOLDEN_ATTACKS` (18), `YAML_SNIPPET`
- **page-pricing:** `TIERS` (4), `RATE` (cloud cost model)
- **page-trust:** `FRAMEWORKS` (3), `ARTIFACTS` (3)
- **page-about:** `PILLARS` (4)
- **page-contact:** `THROUGHPUTS`, `BACKENDS`, `THERMALS`, `PGP_KEY_BLOCK`

If lead capture is added, the RESTful Table API (`tables/{table}`) is the intended store.

---

## 8. Public URLs

Not yet deployed. Use the **Publish tab** for one-click deploy, or request a Hosted Deploy.
Production target: `https://aryorithm.com`.

---

## 9. Project Structure

```
index.html              Shell — meta, fonts, Tailwind token config, React/Babel CDN, script order
css/style.css           Design system: tokens, grid backdrop, glow utilities, animations,
                        terminal scanlines, reduced-motion overrides, a11y focus states
js/shared.jsx           Shared shell, router, CodeViewer, Breadcrumb, copyText helper
js/page-*.jsx           Ten page modules (see Architecture above)
js/router.jsx           Route table and ReactDOM mount
README.md               This document
```

**Script order matters:** `shared` → page modules → `router`.

  // Strip the encapsulation header FIRST, then read the pointers.
  if (bpf_xdp_adjust_head(ctx, 4))
    return XDP_DROP;

  // FIX 1: re-load both pointers after every adjust_head call.
  void *data     = (void *)(long)ctx->data;
  void *data_end = (void *)(long)ctx->data_end;

// Runs in the verdict path; must be allocation-free and branch-cheap.

namespace aryorithm::dissect {

struct ModbusPdu {
  std::uint16_t transaction_id;
  std::uint16_t protocol_id;
  std::uint16_t length;
  std::uint8_t  unit_id;
  std::uint8_t  function_code;
  std::uint16_t address;
  std::uint16_t value;
};

constexpr std::uint8_t kForceSingleCoil = 0x05;

// Verdict for a write-coil request against the learned physical envelope.
Verdict inspect_write_coil(std::span<const std::byte> frame,
                           const ConstraintMap &envelope) noexcept {
  if (frame.size() < sizeof(ModbusPdu))
    return Verdict::malformed();

  const auto pdu = parse_be<ModbusPdu>(frame);   // byte-safe, no copy
  if (pdu.function_code != kForceSingleCoil)
    return Verdict::pass();

  // 1. Is this source authorised to write at all?
  if (!envelope.is_authorised_writer(pdu.unit_id))
    return Verdict::drop(Reason::UnauthorisedWriter);

  // 2. Is the coil inside the writable range for this unit?
  if (!envelope.coil_writable(pdu.unit_id, pdu.address))
    return Verdict::drop(Reason::AddressOutOfEnvelope);

  // 3. Would the resulting state violate a physical interlock?
  //    e.g. opening a valve while the downstream pump is de-energised.
  if (envelope.violates_interlock(pdu.unit_id, pdu.address, pdu.value))
    return Verdict::drop(Reason::InterlockViolation);

  return Verdict::pass();
}

}  // namespace aryorithm::dissect

Migration complete. The modular Next.js project lives at `E:\Project\aryorithm-next`.

**Verification (all evidenced, not assumed):**
- `tsc --noEmit` — zero errors
- `next build` — `✓ Compiled successfully`, 15/15 static routes prerendered
- Production smoke test (`next start` + HTTP checks) — all 15 routes return **200**
- Content checks — all 12 deep-link anchors and key markers present (`roi-calculator`, `pgp-panel` + fingerprint `9E42 81BC`, `sbom-repository`, `ebpf-challenge` + `EBPF-XDP-2026`, `safety-gate`, `subsystem-matrix`, …)
- Air-gap grep — zero external CDN/script origins in `app/`, `components/`, `data/`, `lib/` (fonts via `next/font` self-host at build time)

**What was built:**
- **Design system** — exact theme tokens, `Space Grotesk`/`Inter`/`JetBrains Mono` via `next/font`, all utilities/keyframes ported 1:1 from `css/style.css`
- **Data layer** (`data/`, fully typed) — all 26 modules, 30 plugins, 15 silicon platforms, 6 fast-path stages, 4 tiers + cloud-rate formula, 3 frameworks + 3 SBOM digests, 4 pillars, throughputs/backends/thermals + PGP block, fleet/canary/PCR sets, SLAB fields, harness transcript, leaders/roles/eBPF snippets, portal license logic, 4 publications, 8 FAQs — zero hardcoded matrices in JSX
- **Components** — `Header` (usePathname pip + dropdowns), `Footer`, `MobileDrawer`, `Breadcrumb`; `CodeViewer` (same regex tokenizer), `CopyButton` (Clipboard-API-reject fallback), `TelemetryCounter` (`useInView`/`useCountUp`), `Accordion`, `StatusBadge`/`StatStrip`; simulations `TopologyCanvas`, `RoiCalculator` (exact log-scale formula + one-shot reveal), `HardwareSizer` (exact 4 warning rules), `EbpfChallenge`, `LicenseGenerator` + Nexus HUD/CLI, fast-path, Forge gate, lab, portal auth, contact portals
- **15 routes** per spec, with `ClosingCTA` suppressed on `/contact` and `/portal` (matching original router), skip-link + semantic landmarks preserved

Two config fixes were needed along the way (Next 14.2 requires `next.config.js` over `.ts`, and PostCSS config must be CommonJS) — both resolved and re-verified with a clean final build.
